info.description: Anonymous carts persisted from the storefront, keyed by a client-generated cartToken. Public role reaches these through the token-scoped custom routes only — there is no find-all and no delete.

cartToken.description: Random opaque id generated by the browser (crypto.randomUUID) and kept in localStorage. There is no login, so this is the only thing tying a cart to a visitor — treat it as a bearer secret: anyone holding it can read and write that cart.

items.description: Snapshot of the cart at the time of the last sync: [{ slug, name, qty, price, image }]. Denormalised on purpose — the row should show what the shopper saw, and must still render if the product is later unpublished or repriced.

subtotal.description: Whole rupees, as calculated by the client from the same snapshot.

status.description: active = in play; recovered = they came back and converted (set only by the markRecovered route). Public writes can never set this.

lastActivityAt.description: Last time the shopper touched the cart. Stamped from the server clock on every write.

recoveredAt.description: When markRecovered was called. Null until a checkout exists to call it.
